title: FSSAI Registration for a Home Food Business: Basic vs State Licence, Fees and FoSCoS Steps (2026)
seoTitle: FSSAI Registration for Home Food Business: 2026 Rules
seoDescription: Home bakers and tiffin services need FSSAI registration: ₹100 a year up to ₹1.5 crore turnover since April 2026, no renewal. Category, steps and labels.
excerpt: The new ₹1.5 crore limit, which FoSCoS category a tiffin service or home baker should pick, the Caterer trap, kitchen and label basics, and what Swiggy, Zomato or your own website need.
